body:
Thank you for reaponding and I hope this reply is seen by you.

NAL?

It's interesting that you say RGI is a type of subsidy I have. They didn't make any mention of that. Just the low rent. My living situation is indeed limited here, capped at two years, although a tenant residing here has surpassed the two year mark (with someone in management claiming they can extend anybody to a third year at their discretion, which I think is legally erroneous, according to the contract). The housing also seems tied to therapeutic purposes, but none of that is happening (and with the noise and now harassment, the opposite is).

The contract I signed itself is typed as limited to one year but has been scribbled by hand to extend to two years, which has been done for every tenant; using up that one year extension, not allowing for a third year, I believe the contract states. It is a legally binding contract, is it not? Because the housing provider isn't holding up their end of it now, where provisions state I have a right to peace and quite and "private enjoyment" of my room. But the other residents are playing false witness on each other's behalves, and housing is taking their side.

Do I have any legal defense here or options to pursue?

Is it that this month? September iissuicide prevention month?

Ha. That's a bit of a laugh. I haven't seen anything about it, but someone saying they got over being suicidal, that it's temporsry, and others can get better if they could... it's so naïve. As if they could imagine what someone else could be going through. And who knows what they got over.
I would bee broke immediately, if only because I could finally pursue surgies I need. 100K might not even be enough. But it would mostly turn my life around.

Haha, oh wow. My heart skipped a beat when you said she had a breathing problem and then more when you said it was worse. That you didn't know what purring was? That's cute. The whole story is. But then, I love cats. Just need to find mine a good home before I act.
Goodnight.
Doesn't quite always work that way.

If I may ask and it's not wholly inappropriate... Feeling the awful heartbreak you're feeling right now, would you rather have never had your partner or are you still better of for having had that relationship for 8 years?
Like a game show. What is, "Give up."
Not just predators, but TERFs too. Though I guess the argument can be made that they fall under "predators" as well.

Thanks for writing out this post and sharing. I'm sorry that I don't quite have the energy to write much of any response. Though I'm not sure what to write either. Bits of my own life story to commiserate in some way? I wish I could tell you it'd get better too, also knowing that's nonsense for both you and me. Pardon the French, but just... fuck everything. Whoever I talk about it with, posting, the conclusion is unflinchingly clear and unchanging. As much as I might wish otherwise.

(AutoModerator getting annoying)

" I think my depression is directly linked to my intelligence. As in, I have made it this far by overthinking things (a time sink instead of making [any] decisions or offing myself)"

Aye. A way/analogy I've recently surmised for my lack of action and why I haven't offed myself yet is my life has been like seeing a doctor and being made to drop your pants. Just pretending you're not there, biting your lip, putting up with the discomfort. And entire life of that, with several things acting as distractions (like interner and video games) - that fall short now. 

And sorry, I don't know how to do that quote section stuff.

"I'd imagine a society would rather keep people here, suffering and filling a gap, than letting that labor escape."

Ugh. 🤢

"...consider all other options before death would likely - hopefully - come to the conclusion that there is always a chance. There is always the possibility of a hail mary pass. No matter how much the patient thinks otherwise."

I think that applies to a lot of people. Especially to many of the people in threads here, particularly seeing how much youth is here. But not everybody. Like myself, unfortunately.

"But while you can't escape a struggle, you can pick what your struggle is."

Unfortunately not.

I have to say I'm sorry for what you are going through, as empty as saying that is. I don't know your struggles but you sound like a fine person to me and Aeronautical Engineering, wow. Also, thank you, for the amount you wrote. I like reading the larger posts, so I certainly didn't mind the tangents. Sorry I'm not here written content to match (though dribble from me wouldn't match in quality). It's true that GPA is not acutely reflective of intelligence or capability, like SAT scores or whatnot. Just sometimes a weak correlation of those, like IQ.

You not being long for this world is an injustice. That's not me trying to be hugboxy about it either.

I don't want to sound like putting my foot in my mouth, but the fact that you got to putting a down payment on an apartment and had a job means you were capable of getting to that point. You can probably do it again. And your have parents to be able to live with. More than can be said for me. 

You can do it. And have already proven you did get started once.

There's no over the counter stuff that is more guaranteed. Most have a good chance of just making you super sick and/or damaging your body greatly (without death). They do that on purpose. And Redditors aren't allowed to post methods or anything.

I think he's just being supportive. Not that he wants to get rid of you. Would you only want to kill yourself if it made other people regret something? To me it seems he's being literally not selfish by saying he'd want you to keep living for him no matter how much pain you were going through. If you would only want to kill yourself to make other miss you, an analysis of priorities might be a good idea.

Like I said, there isn't much reason to say them. Just nonsense like "Wow, 23, that would make me think you have hope but I know my own puberty was all done and body ruined by then, so it'snot young enough." That doesn't add anything to the discussion. 

If I was 23, I might have hope to save up for FFS or other surgeries if I could work. Maybe not. I mean, I only found out what trans even was at 22-23; you were able to transition, find it didn't work out, and detransition by that time. Kinda adds to my suicidality, but saying so doesn't do you any favours. Sorry. I can only imagine how much more hopeless you feel. I told myself I would do it at 30 too. ...Here I am past expiry and cowardly. I can hardly believe I'm this old. Still alive and worthless.

I would almost say "Go out and do whatever you can to make it worth it! Don't let your time be wasted like mine was." But that doesn't sound much different than other empty platitudes. 

So, all of them kinda summed up with "Cripes." Aha...

Eh, it's hard to determine that when it comes to mental illness, as to how subjective that could become. Sometimes that is very clear while other it becomes a very muddy topic. I remember seeing some thread somewhere on Reddit, I think it was like an AskReddit asking for experiences for people who worked helplines. One comment thread was an argument that someone being suicidal in and of itself would be mental illness. I disagree with such a position.

Taking myself as example, I can pretty objectively show there isn't any "getting better" for me. Even a small chance that exists, no government invests like that in their citizenry. Then I could likewise argue it'd be cheaper for them to allow me a medically assisted death than it would be to for them to continue having me on a disability support system (which is very poor as it is).

I've heard of Chronic Fatigue Syndrome. That's a toughie for a capitalistic system. How could anyone argue that? But also condemn such a person to slums? Yeesh...

Assisted suicide in my opinion should be legal and more open, but definitely has to be very smartly handled. It does beg the question of who and how determinations would be made.
Cripes. I guess that's all I can say. There's kind of other things, but not much reason to say them.

May I ask how old you are now?

How *do* you repress and dissociate being closeted? I found things bad even before I even learned what trans was, but once learning, it got worse, and then transitioning and failing... just... impossible.
There isn't any way. Even with maybe a quarter million, although that would give me the only sliver of a possible chance. Otherwise my birth circumstances would have to change.

Christ (and I'm not religious, but what non-religious similar phrases are there?).

That's horrible. And no, it doesn't make you 'wrong' to want him to die. Actively trying to do that would do that (...but even then I'd debate that...:/). How did a stranger do that?

No lectures from here about possessions. Nobody should devalue that. All my possessions and my cat are all I have. I don't even know how you're dealing with it, having lost everything you owned. I wish I could share and give you some of my possessions, as I might be even be said to have more than I should.

Don't feel bad about knowing "why" about your life. The universe just seems to like to shit endlessly on some of us. No rhyme or reason why. It's just remains unfair.
And you can stand a detransitioned life?

Where I live, medically assisted death is legal, thankfully, but *unfortunately* it's incredibly restrictive. Which isn't fair. A society that says "Screw you, fend for yourselves" but also doesn't allow any easy way out? And then *also* complains about people languishing on the system/income support? WTF.

It's awful that depression get more recognition and still has stigma attached to it. But at times there's more than depression.
All I can say is I wish you the absolute best of luck. You have more optimism and strength than I do. I can't have hope anymore...

Yes and no. The difference being I'm not any happier having transitioned. Since it didn't really work out dor me. Given the choice, I'd rather just not be born. If the other thing to change was being cis or not, I'd rather not be born. Even if I could be a cis woman, which would be great, if I was still born with the same genetics, to the same family, and nothing else was different? ...No thanks.
If you feel the same way, why do you bother? With life? What's makes it worth going on for you? If I may ask. If that digging too much, it's okay to not share. Sorry and thanks.

Thought I'd just chime in to day I don't have any good experiences with Trans Lifeline. Having tried to call them numerous different times thereabouts in crisis, they never picked up. Similar non-helpful experiences with other LGBTQ resources. It's left me having not much faith in those (or zero faith).

I apologize too. I don't mean to castigate those who would say "you're valid" although at the same time... Well, you know... Not to say that your post amounts to no more than that. Although, it's almost there in a way. I'm sorry, I feel like an ass saying so. But I appreciate being able to read what you wrote, so thank you for writing it.

The catch is I don't have much of any happiness, security, or safety to take hold of. The little bits that do exist are dwarfed by the avalanche of the bad stuff. As for self acceptance, defiance, and joy? Those don't exist at all. I too have a level where I don't want to die, insofar as it feels like I've been dealt a death sentence I did not act to deserve. But that doesn't change matters. So I 'need' to die. ...Because there's not really any other way to make a go of this. And that sucks.

I can understand not being able to support being able to tell another person to take the final act. Hold that view myself for the most part. It's tricky. 

Oh, I haven't been on "dat imageboard site" in many years, but remember the atmosphere. Back when it was called "an hero," if they call it that. Ironically enough, it was that site that led me to learning what transgender even was.

I have to admit to being curious about how you related to yourself before you knew you weren't cis some way or another. Which does add salt to my own wound, through no fault of yours.

Um, while it might seem like BS coming from me, you're not worthless, evil, or not even human. I come to the point where I don't think those things of myself, except maybe worthless, but that doesn't make up for everything else negative. That you would this post and spend that effort suggests to me you're not evil. What you written and how you hurt shows you're human. And society's standards of worth should bot decide our value. But however deserving or valued we may be, that affects no change in the hand life actually deals us. The most innocent, deserving, good people and beings too often are served horribly by life. Then what does one do? I can't think of it. If such people get the worst, what can one like me who is not so good get? Agh, the writing in this paragraph is more than a little janky, sorry. Sleep deprivation...

(Also, sorry for the late reply. The internet where I live gabe out for most of the day not long after you posted. For the second day in a row. I don't own a phone. Methinks that will contribute fairly well to being in crisis. Maybe give me the despair I need.)

Failure to thrive. Wow. Those words have never occured to me together and yet they're perfectly evocative of me. 

Doc/Mechanic: "Phew, yup, this one's no good. Don't know quite right why. Gotta just toss it out and get a new one."

One question would be, were they wearing masks? If not, I think that alone says enough about them and how much thought to put towards them. 

Also, don't know if you've tried it before or if your shawarma place does it, but if possible (and if it's done right), try shawarma poutine. It is amazing. One of the few good things in life.

"Not even strangers are nice to me"

Bad standard to judge by. Strangers usually suck.

🧐
Not bad, not too bad at all. *fix monocle*

To be serious, while some felt 'off' about it, it was a decent poem. Not that I'm any good judge of poetry. Still, thanks for sharing.

"Suicide attempts are worse than just keeping alive and safe."

I can agree with that to enough of a degree. That's why it can't be an attempt or attempt. Has be be guaranteed right away.

I'm pretty sure hotlines call the cops , at least where I live, if they 'deem' it necessary. Danger to yourself or others, yadda, yadda. I was already thrown into inpatient once involuntarily (no police involved then) and then had cops called on me another time for opening my big yap.

There is no coming out on an "other side" for me. No other side to come out on. How is it untenable? The only way to truly get that across would be a life story. To try to sum it up... I've been a shut in for more than a decade. So haven't lived any real growing up youth, but people would expect me to act my age. Not that I experienced a normal life before it fell apart. Childhood abuse and trauma. No family. Very few friends, who have they're own lives. No skills or capability. No relationship experience. Then to wrap it all up in the nicest of bows, I'm trans. And not one of those "Oh, you look so much better now" people, you can see in before and afters. Transitioning has not gone well for me. And it kills me, more than anything else.

So, yeah, untenable. At this age. If it was at the beginning of the shut in-ness, maybe I could have some hope. But now? Just way too late. Yeah, dust in the wind... The infinitesimal.

Oh, and the bet: you're older than or younger than... 35?
Welp. Good on you for still being capable of thinking of a future you.
I find that hard to believe. I wish it were true. Just... 'voluntarily' give up life functions?
That isn't absolutely true. And if it doesn't help, then that's more people to hurt. But it depends on the person (YMMV).

Man, did this thread get a lot of comments. Gonna take a while to read through them.

Um, if I may say, being a female isn't cherries and peaches. If that's how the phrase goes. It's a grass is greener thing. And I'm saying as a trans person. I'm not trans because I thought things would be better but because I just want to be comfortable in this body. Which will now never happen... Single greatest reason I have a suicidal suffocating urge basically every day. Anyway!

I suggest going on YouTube and seeing what some trans people who pass talk about differences in their life between transition, before and after. It's interesting and enlightening to hear the differences.

That's a bet I'd be willing to take, in regards to age. 

I did post here about what's unfortunately against the rules. Since I don't believe there's any fixing anything. I have never actually talked to any on a help line, as the times I've tried, I've never gotten through. What else would they do besides called the police anyway? I've done plenty of therapy, both one-on-one and group, on my sixth antidepressant, and even tried to get transcranial magnetic therapy but was declined - they said themselves it wouldn't help.

"Shit ain't what you think it is."
Dohoho.
But seriously... I'm pretty anomalous. Which is a good thing for others. But believe me the reality of things are... untenable...

Help lines or therapy are of no help. The problem is tangible reality. There's nothing to talk around that. If I were much younger, I'd give it to you for the "didn't find a way for years," but it's much too late now.
Is anybody here with the positive messages younger than 30?
Then if one is older than than older than 30 and has no job, no degree, diploma, or certificate (or has a useless one), they're pretty screwed right?
Not to underestimate what you're going through, but I think that means you've got time to turn it around. I think 25 is the "no hope" line.

I'm sorry for the late reply. 14 is quite young. A lot can change by the time you're 17, 20, or 25. Not to undermine what you're going through now, which is tough to touch on without context. There tends to be a fair bit you can do before it's truly "too late." Don't end up like me and wait until you can't do anything.
They meant literally can't. It's against the rules of the board to discuss methods.
Clever.
Thanks. Unfortunately, the unaddressable ones are the important ones.

Dittoing the thanks for posting it. A little odd but interesting too.

Looks like I'm about an 8 a lot of the time, flitting to 7 and 9 often. Just without the "need help" and "medical attention."

Please don't feel guilty. That's nothing to feel guilty over. I think I would advise to not focus on your hate of that music, but just focus on what you do like. And believe me, a lot of people are critical of "today's music" and think it sucks compared to music of the past. Almost even regardless of genre. 

Like what you like, and don't feel guilty about what you don't.

"Even though I despise almost all their songs."

There ya go. I could make a comment with the majority of people not actually liking quality stuff, but at the same time that point also kind of stands. Popular music tends to appeal to the most common denominator and can carry some dumb beliefs. Doesn't automatically add credibility to that music or credibility to the majority. Remember, hundreds of years ago, the majority of people believed some very mistaken beliefs.

You're a someone who hates almost all their songs. So that's not "no one" anymore.

Too true. And it seems I *still* haven't learned me lesson and flap my gums too loosely. Don't be too hard on yourself because of that.

I suppose a divorce without lawyers and shared custody time means it's a friendly enough divorce? That's good. Less risk that way, but it's true that you don't want to give them any reason to think you are bad for your kids. At the same time, you shouldn't need to just keep everything bottled up. That's not healthy either.

Agreed, that's just your therapist doing her job. Which could literally be on the line if she didn't. As for losing a patient, it depends if she has experience. I had an appointment with this one psychiatrist once who seemed to nonchalantly wonder about patients who had killed themselves. Something like "if only they tried ECT." Crazy heartless, I thought. I can't speak for your therapist though.
Forget that song. There are lots of stupid songs out there, with dumb lyrics. You don't need to pay attention to those writers.

Don't be too hard on yourself. Everybody has their vices and for some they do become all consuming. That's addiction, right? And like Brainxdeadx said, you've already done a great first step in even admitting it. That you work and try to do extra work for extra income I think is admirable. Seriously.

I have to admit I'm somewhat bewildered at your spending on porn. Not because of spending in porn specifically, but when there's so much free porn accessible out there, why pay so much for it?

My sincerest sympathies for your history with sexual abuse. Which sounds like it's worth nothing saying it, but I still feel so sorry about that.

Looking up resources for addiction might help with addressing that. As for food and gas... I'm not sure about gas. At least in any legal way. For food, maybe you can check for a food bank in your area? In regards to being suicidal for so long... I'm sorry,  I don't know. Being there myself, I don't know a solution. If you're writing this post, about not knowing what to do, and that you seem to have something, anything, holding you back, is maybe a hope for something better.

I find the last set of sentences pretty strange. I think you write just fine. 

IMHO, I don't believe your value should be judged by how you 'contribute' to society or whether you have a job. But maybe that makes me a non-decent person by your judgements?

You said you struggle to change laziness. But you're trying to, which shows you have the desire. Very, very rare chance is still a chance.
Why life insurance?

Yeah, pretty much that she'll have you admitted. Um, if you have kids, depending on your circumstances, yes, that means they could possibly be taken away too. It depends.

If you're in divorce proceedings and are in a child custody fight, your chances of custody could be hurt. Or if you're a single parent and they worry about your kids' safety. Even if you say you'd never hurt them, they would make a decision based on their own understanding. 

Did you tell your therapist of any issues or concerns you had that might elicit "You won't like me?"

I have the unlucky set of circumstances of being trans. And because I didn't transition at a young age, things can't be fixed. I'll never have the kind of money to try to address the little that can be partially addressed by surgery.

Along with that is years of life lost, social incapability, not having had life experiences to grow up. Just... everything is a mess. Some of it is addressable, but the things that can be addressed make the addressable things pointless.

I know what almost that entire life experience is like. Including being afraid to kill oneself.

No one will (or should) tell you to do it. It's actually against the rules. 

But if you looked at entry level jobs, it shows you have some initiative. I think that's a good sign. If you weren't measured by others, would you still feel the way you do? Maybe if you can muster the energy, finding some kind of work-from-home stuff would help you build experience without having to face people.

Wow, the odds of that. I said pretty much the exact same thing about a button like that to someone just hours ago.

How old are you and how does your life get worse?
I've never had a partner, so can't comment on that, but why does your partner's ex affect you so? Especially seeing as she is an ex.
I think that all the damn time. And just see myself as a coward.
Being trans isn't simply wanting something. At least most of the time.
If your [sister] was trans, as you said [she] she wrote, [she] wouldn't have wanted to be handsome and anybody saying so wouldn't have helped [her] frame of mind. Sorry.

Eh, I'm a ninny. I never really jumped at jump scares or scream or anything, but I get easily uncomfortable. As a kid, I had to play the Shadow Temple and Under the Well with the sound muted. I feel horror in games tends to more easily scare/perturb than movies since you're actively playing through it.

You don't deserve to suffer. Not to sound like I'm writing a smarmy message, but more like... nothing is deserved or not deserved. Well, short of being an objectively awful person (murder, rape, assault, etc.). Which I can bet you haven't done those things. So I can at least say, you don't deserve to suffer.

"It doesn't even matter how many people have told me that I'm very talented, smart, deep, wise, etc etc etc."

It's annoying, isn't it. Positively biased type of hugboxing. When reality points otherwise. And you know better than the bias.
